title: 🚀 BETA TESTERS WANTED!
author: kizashi_ai_0630
selftext:
Winning or losing isn’t the whole story.

Why did you enter?  
Did you follow your rules?  
What made you hesitate?

Every trade leaves behind valuable information.

KIZASHI helps you review your charts, trade history, and trading patterns with AI — so you can better understand your own decisions.

Not to predict the future.  
**To make your next decision clearer.**

🌊 **KIZASHI — Your Trading Assistant**  
From hesitation to confidence.
